description: Fetch the full text of a FactLot knowledge document by the id returned from search. With a registry loaded, a registry fact's source document_id (fl:document:sha256-…) returns that source snapshot: publisher, dataset, URL, retrieval date, as-of date, licence, AI-use and redistribution rights, file name and size.

id.description: Document id from search, e.g. tool:calc_cam_reconciliation, or a registry source snapshot's FactLot document ID (fl:document:sha256-…) when a registry is loaded.

name: fetch
title: Fetch a FactLot knowledge document
